channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Sudan army accused of drone strike on livestock market
item.description: Sudan’s army says it struck RSF command centres in South Darfur, but the RSF says a crowded livestock market was hit.

item.title: Who is Mehrdad Akhlaghi, Iran’s new tech-focused defence minister?
item.description: Akhlaghi's experience centres on ballistic missiles, aerospace technology and defence-industrial production.

item.title: What help can Egypt offer Saudi Arabia in the war against the Houthis?
item.description: Analysts say that any move from Egypt will remain 'strictly defensive', as the conflict in Yemen intensifies.

item.title: Egypt to provide ‘necessary’ support to Saudi Arabia amid Houthi attacks
item.description: Presidency says Egypt will provide Saudi Arabia with support to defend its security and protect its resources.

item.title: Rubio says Ukraine without access to Starshield, future ‘under discussion’
item.description: Top US diplomat says Ukraine has requested access to military-grade version of Starlink for strikes deep inside Russia.

item.title: Fighting intensifies across Yemen as humanitarian crisis deepens
item.description: Clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis cause casualties on both sides as aid agencies warn of humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
item.description: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

item.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
item.description: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

item.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
item.description: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.

item.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
item.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.
